# argos-sandbox

License: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (`LICENSE.md`): source-available, free for
individuals and noncommercial use; companies and other commercial entities need a
commercial licence with Argos maintenance keys (`COMMERCIAL.md`). Not open source
in the OSI sense.

The Argos module sandbox on wasmtime: approved WASM only (SHA-384), rights
denied by default, fuel, memory and time limits, bounded host calls with their
own time budget and cancellation, and the file, network and local AI services.
Independent of the private governance core: it only receives an `Approval`.
